黃仁勳走了還沒完！美財長開砲商務部 輝達也得說清楚

輝達(NVDA-US)風波進一步延燒至川普政府內部。據《金融時報》與《彭博》報導，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)公開表示，財政部等多個部門數月來一直支持將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，但決策權掌握在商務部手中。他也要求追究輝達相關人員的責任，質疑公司是否充分查核客戶並防止晶片流入中國。全文詳讀
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares remain under pressure, down 14.4% so far this week and facing a possible sixth consecutive losing week – the longest weekly losing streak in 14 years – wiping about $657.2 billion of market value in a single week. With earnings due next Tuesday, the market will not only scrutinize the results but also look at share‑buyback activity, the CEO succession plan, and whether key partnerships with companies such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM-US) remain stable.

Wall Street has not completely abandoned Nvidia (NVDA-US). Although some analysts have adjusted price targets and a few have cut ratings this week, many still maintain bullish views. Wedbush analyst Matthew Bryson’s report reflects this sentiment: on Friday the 13th, ahead of Nvidia’s earnings release, he wrote, “Nothing has changed. We again expect Nvidia to deliver results that beat forecasts and that its Q4 revenue outlook will exceed Wall Street expectations.”

Nvidia’s senior‑management changes are unlikely to have an immediate direct impact on major Asian semiconductor suppliers such as Samsung Electronics and TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM-US). However, Jensen Huang’s departure raises questions about Nvidia’s long‑term product strategy and supply‑chain collaborations. For investors and suppliers, the key issues are whether Nvidia can sustain its historic pace of innovation and preserve the close partner relationships that Huang cultivated to cement the company’s AI‑chip leadership.

The AI IPO boom is running into geopolitical hurdles. According to foreign media citing informed sources on Friday the 13th, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is facing obstacles for Chinese and Hong Kong institutional investors to subscribe to its upcoming IPO. Despite recent volatility in AI stocks, the deal has attracted strong buying interest, with potential investors expressing demand roughly six times the number of shares being offered.

U.S. export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China have led to a new finding: former OpenAI researcher Will DePue disclosed on Friday the 13th that six AI models – DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and three models from Ant Group – show a “hardware fingerprint” in their publicly released weights that matches Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) Blackwell chip. The fingerprint suggests the hardware used during model initialization, though the location of the chips and how the firms obtained the compute remain unclear.

The Nvidia controversy has spilled further into the U.S. administration. Financial Times and Bloomberg report that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly said the Treasury and several other agencies have supported placing Megaspeed on the trade blacklist for months, but the final decision rests with the Commerce Department. He also called for accountability of Nvidia personnel, questioning whether the company has adequately vetted customers and prevented its chips from reaching China.

items.title: AI代理夯 LangChain募3億美元 估值達30億
items.title_en: AI Agent Startup LangChain Raises $300 Million, Valued at $3 Billion
paras: AI代理管理新創LangChain宣布完成3億美元C輪募資，估值達30億美元，由Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下創投CapitalG領投。新加坡主權基金GIC、DFJ Growth、IVP與Sapphire Ventures也參與投資，累計募資總額達4.6億美元。
本輪其他投資人包括Salesforce Ventures、Insight Venture Partners、QuantumLight及MongoDB Ventures；既有投資人Sequoia、Amplify與Benchmark也加入。LangChain未公布這筆資金的具體用途，但公司表示將於11月20日展示LangSmith的新功能。
新估值約為一年前的2.4倍。LangChain當時募得1.25億美元，估值為12.5億美元，由IVP領投；此次融資反映投資人持續看好企業導入AI代理的需求。
LangChain於2022年以開源專案起家，早期協助大型語言模型搜尋網路、呼叫API及操作資料庫。隨著OpenAI、Anthropic及Google等模型業者提升模型處理這類工作的能力，LangChain將業務重心轉向AI代理的建置、部署與管理。
公司的核心產品LangSmith提供AI代理的執行、測試、監控、改善與治理工具。LangChain主打模型與雲端中立，讓企業自行選擇模型、掌握資料及基礎設施，避免被單一供應商綁定。
LangChain表示，已有超過7,000個組織使用LangSmith，客戶包括新創Harvey、Rippling與Listen Labs，以及輝達(NVDA-US)、豐田(TM-US)、Salesforce(CRM-US)、Workday(WDAY-US)等企業。
公司舉例，Clay透過LangSmith每月監控數億次AI代理執行並改善代理效能；Workday則運用該平台在企業內部署及管理代理，將推出新代理所需時間從五個月縮短至不到一天。
不過，AI代理管理市場競爭升溫，其他新創也主打開放選擇模型與企業自主治理等賣點。LangChain的先行優勢與7,000多個組織客戶，有助其建立市場基礎；後續能否把開源開發者社群轉化為穩定的企業軟體收入，仍是高估值能否持續的關鍵。
paras_en: AI agent management startup LangChain announced the completion of a $300 million Series C round, valuing the company at $3 billion. The round was led by CapitalG, the venture arm of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). Singapore sovereign fund GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures also participated, bringing the total amount raised to $460 million.

Other investors in this round included Salesforce Ventures, Insight Venture Partners, QuantumLight and MongoDB Ventures; existing backers Sequoia, Amplify and Benchmark also participated. LangChain did not disclose the specific use of the funds, but said it will showcase new features of LangSmith on November 20.

The new valuation is about 2.4 times that of a year ago. At that time LangChain raised $125 million at a $1.25 billion valuation, led by IVP; this financing reflects investors’ continued confidence in demand for AI agents in enterprises.

LangChain started in 2022 as an open‑source project, initially helping large language models search the web, call APIs and operate databases. As model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have improved their ability to handle these tasks, LangChain has shifted its focus to building, deploying and managing AI agents.

The company’s core product, LangSmith, provides tools for executing, testing, monitoring, improving and governing AI agents. LangChain emphasizes model‑ and cloud‑agnosticism, allowing enterprises to choose their own models, control data and infrastructure, and avoid vendor lock‑in.

LangChain says more than 7,000 organizations use LangSmith, with customers ranging from startups like Harvey, Rippling and Listen Labs to enterprises such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Toyota (TM‑US), Salesforce (CRM‑US) and Workday (WDAY‑US).

The company cites examples such as Clay, which monitors hundreds of millions of AI agent executions each month via LangSmith and improves agent performance, and Workday, which uses the platform to deploy and manage agents internally, cutting the time to launch a new agent from five months to less than a day.

However, competition in the AI agent management market is heating up, with other startups also touting open model choice and enterprise‑controlled governance. LangChain’s first‑mover advantage and its base of over 7,000 organizational customers help it build market footing, but whether it can convert its open‑source developer community into stable enterprise software revenue will determine if the high valuation is sustainable.

items.title: Fed猛烈升息恐成2027年美股最大風險！經濟學家警告市場低估緊縮幅度
items.title_en: Fed’s Aggressive Rate Hikes Could Become the Biggest Risk to US Stocks in 2027, Economists Warn Market Underestimates Tightening
paras: 美國 10 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增 0.3%，加深市場對聯準會 (Fed) 加快升息的疑慮。Renaissance Macro Research 首席經濟學家 Neil Dutta 週二 (10 日) 警告，投資人仍在關注人工智慧 (AI) 類股漲勢能否延續，但隨著失業率下降、勞動市場轉強，通膨卻進一步偏離 Fed 的 2% 目標，升息過頭正迅速成為 2027 年美股面臨的最大風險之一。
「我確實認為，貨幣政策過度緊縮是一大風險，」Dutta 接受《MarketWatch》採訪時表示。「目前失業率正在下降，勞動市場正在轉強，而通膨離 Fed 的目標越來越遠。」
Fed 理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 週二稍早在倫敦演說時表示，若當天公布的 10 月核心 CPI 月增率與前兩個月相近，維持在 0.3% 左右甚至更高，Fed 可能需要採取更強力的行動，應在 12 月會議上考慮一次升息 2 碼 (50 個基點)。
隨後公布的核心 CPI 月增率為 0.3%，落在華勒點名的區間，美債殖利率應聲攀升，美股期貨則轉跌。
Dutta 表示，華勒的看法在 Fed 內部有多少支持，仍有待觀察。不過，從最新 CPI 等官方數據來看，現行利率對物價的抑制力道仍然有限。儘管原油價格自美國期中選舉後回落，柴油等成品油價格依然偏高，10 月通膨數據也顯示，租金漲幅可能再度加快。
Dutta 指出，如果住房成本漲勢無法放緩，通膨將很難回到 2% 目標。
「Fed 對通膨前景仍過於樂觀，市場也低估了政策需要收緊的程度，」Dutta 在給客戶的報告中寫道。
升息會推高企業融資成本，較高的利率也會壓低未來獲利的現值，使仰賴長期成長預期支撐估值的股票承受更大壓力。
Fed 未來數月還將累計升息 2 碼，大致符合官員 9 月公布的利率預測。
Dutta 認為，這樣的幅度可能仍不夠。他指出，Fed 在 2025 年曾為防範經濟下行風險累計降息 3 碼，「把去年的預防性降息全數收回，是目前最低限度該做的事。」
paras_en: US core consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.3% month‑on‑month, deepening market doubts that the Federal Reserve will accelerate rate hikes. Neil Dutta, chief economist at Renaissance Macro Research, warned on Tuesday the 10th that investors are still watching whether AI‑related stocks can keep climbing, but as unemployment falls and the labour market strengthens, inflation is drifting further from the Fed’s 2% target, and an over‑tightening could quickly become one of the biggest risks to US equities in 2027.

"I do think that overly tight monetary policy is a major risk," Dutta told MarketWatch. "Unemployment is currently falling, the labour market is strengthening, and inflation is moving farther away from the Fed’s goal."

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said in a speech in London on Tuesday that if the October core CPI month‑on‑month increase reported that day is similar to the previous two months—around 0.3% or higher—the Fed may need to take stronger action and could consider a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) hike at the December meeting.
The subsequently released core CPI month‑on‑month figure was 0.3%, landing in the range Waller highlighted; US Treasury yields rose accordingly and US stock futures turned lower.

Dutta noted that it remains to be seen how much support Waller’s view has inside the Fed. However, based on the latest CPI and other official data, the current rate level still has limited power to curb prices. Even though crude oil prices have fallen since the US midterm elections, refined products such as diesel remain pricey, and October inflation data also show that rent growth may be picking up again.
Dutta pointed out that if housing‑cost inflation does not ease, it will be hard for overall inflation to return to the 2% target.
"The Fed is still too optimistic about the inflation outlook, and the market underestimates how much policy needs to tighten," Dutta wrote in a client report.

Higher rates will raise corporate financing costs, and the higher discount rates will depress the present value of future earnings, putting greater pressure on stocks that rely on long‑term growth expectations to justify their valuations.
The Fed is expected to add another 2‑point hike over the next few months, roughly in line with the rate path officials outlined in September.

Dutta believes even that may not be enough. He noted that the Fed cut rates by three points in 2025 to guard against downside risks and said, "Rolling back last year’s pre‑emptive cuts in full is the minimum that should be done now."

items.title: 馬斯克隨川普訪中出席APEC！美官員：不提黃仁勳間諜醜聞、不談晶片管制
items.title_en: Musk Joins Trump on China Visit for APEC; U.S. Officials Say No Talk of Huang Renxun Spy Scandal or Chip Controls
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)預定下周訪問中國，將與中國國家主席習近平三度會晤，美國高階官員周五(13日)晚間向記者表示，川普此行不打算提及輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜發生婚外情一事。
官員也透露，特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克將隨同川普前往中國深圳，出席亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會。
白宮周五稍早表示，川普計劃在訪中期間舉行三方峰會，與中國國家主席習近平及俄羅斯總統普丁會面。
黃仁勳與疑似中國間諜黃樂的關係引發外界疑慮。外界擔心，黃樂曾任高層主管的新加坡公司Megaspeed可能將受美國出口管制的輝達晶片轉運至中國。

川普訪中不談間諜疑雲 美方稱不影響行程

一名匿名美國官員在周五的媒體電話簡報會上說：「輝達的情況不應該對這趟訪問造成任何實質影響。
他說：「在我們與中國進行的所有討論和談判中，我們不會就美國出口管制進行談判……我們也不預料這件事會在我們訪問期間與中國方面的任何對話中占有一席之地。」
當記者詢問川普是否會向習近平提出有關黃樂的指控時，該官員表示：「至少在經濟層面上，與習近平主席會談的重點將是貿易協議的執行情況。」
這名官員進一步說：「至於美國正在進行的部分國家安全事務、審查及調查，目前可能還不是向中國方面透露相關資訊的時候。」另一名官員則說：「我不認為總統會提起這件事。」

黃仁勳辭職風波延燒 輝達晶片疑遭轉運中國

黃仁勳本周辭去輝達執行長職務，先前有媒體報導他曾與黃樂發生婚外情。黃樂曾任雲端運算公司Megaspeed高層，而該公司正因涉嫌協助將價值數十億美元的輝達晶片運往中國、違反美國對相關晶片的出口管制規定受到調查。
這起醜聞重創輝達，也引發外界質疑，由川普友人盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)領導的美國商務部，是否積極阻止先進晶片流入中國。

馬斯克為何隨行？美官員：對美中關係具有重要利益

周五的媒體簡報會上，記者也問到馬斯克為何將隨同川普訪中。馬斯克和黃仁勳都是前一次隨川普訪中的科技業成員。
一名官員表示：「我不想代表總統說明伊隆為何會同行。顯然，他在美中關係中擁有龐大的商業利益。他也是我們國家安全的重要一環。考量總統此行將進行的各項交流，我認為他在許多方面都能提供極大助益，即使只是擔任總統的顧問也一樣。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China next week for a third meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, and a senior U.S. official told reporters on Friday night that Trump does not plan to raise the alleged affair between former Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy.
The official also disclosed that Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk will accompany Trump to Shenzhen for the Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
The White House said earlier on Friday that Trump intends to hold a trilateral summit during his China visit, meeting with President Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Jensen Huang’s relationship with the alleged Chinese spy Huang Le has sparked concerns that Megaspeed, a Singapore firm where Huang Le was a senior executive, might be used to ship Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls into China.

Trump’s China trip will not address the spy allegations, U.S. officials say it will not affect the itinerary. An anonymous U.S. official told a media briefing on Friday, "The Nvidia issue should not have any material impact on this visit."

He added, "In all of our discussions and negotiations with China, we will not negotiate on U.S. export controls… we do not expect this matter to take up any space in our talks with the Chinese side during the visit."

When asked whether Trump would raise accusations against Huang Le with Xi, the official said, "At least on the economic side, the focus of the meeting with President Xi will be the implementation of the trade agreement."

The official further said, "As for the national‑security matters, reviews and investigations the United States is conducting, it may not yet be the time to disclose that information to the Chinese side." Another official added, "I don’t think the president will bring it up."

Jensen Huang’s resignation scandal has intensified, with Nvidia chips suspected of being rerouted to China. Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO this week after media reports of an affair with Huang Le, who previously held a senior role at cloud‑computing firm Megaspeed, now under investigation for allegedly helping ship billions of dollars worth of Nvidia chips to China in violation of U.S. export rules.

The scandal has dealt a heavy blow to Nvidia and raised questions about whether the U.S. Commerce Department, led by Trump ally Howard Lutnick, is actively blocking advanced chips from reaching China.

Why is Musk accompanying Trump? U.S. officials say his presence serves important U.S.–China interests. Reporters asked at the Friday briefing why Musk would travel with Trump; both Musk and Huang were part of the tech delegation on Trump’s previous China trip.

An official said, "I don’t want to speak for the president about why Elon is joining. Clearly, he has huge commercial stakes in U.S.–China relations and is a key part of our national security. Given the range of engagements on this trip, I think he can provide great assistance in many ways, even if only as an adviser to the president."

items.title: 黃仁勳離職市值跌破4兆美元！輝達連六周收黑創14年紀錄 庫藏股護盤、台積電合作受矚
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Market Cap Falls Below $4 Trillion! Nvidia Posts Six Consecutive Weeks of Losses, Sets 14‑Year Record; Share Buybacks Support Price, TSMC Partnership in Focus
paras: 投資人持續消化黃仁勳辭去執行長所帶來的衝擊，輝達(NVDA-US)股價周五(13日)再跌2.01%，收盤市值跌破4兆美元，是2025年7月以來首見。輝達本周共下跌12.7%，連續第六周收黑，創2012年以來最長連跌紀錄，本周市值蒸發5,733.4億美元，則創公司史上單周最大市值損失紀錄。
股價下跌反映市場對人工智慧(AI)支出能否持續的疑慮，以及黃仁勳辭去執行長一職所帶來的後續衝擊。

AI支出回報疑慮仍在 輝達單周跌幅落後晶片股逾20個百分點

根據道瓊市場數據，輝達股價本周下跌12.7%，連續第六周收黑。上一次出現更長的連續周線跌勢，是截至2012年10月的一段六周連跌紀錄。
本周輝達股價表現也明顯落後整體晶片類股。費城半導體指數(SOX)本周上漲8.1%，輝達則落後該指數20.8個百分點。根據道瓊市場數據，這是2008年以來最大的單周落後幅度。
早在黃仁勳的風波受到外界關注之前，輝達股價就已經承受壓力。市場對AI支出能否持續的仍感到擔憂，尤其是新興雲端服務公司的營運狀況，以及在政治環境更加嚴峻的情況下，資料中心建置速度可能放緩。
此外，黃仁勳因被報導與一名和輝達客戶有關聯的高層，以及兩名輝達員工發生婚外情而突然辭去執行長職務，代表公司也必須面對這場風波帶來的後續影響。

下周財報成另一大考驗 克瑞斯暫代執行長

下周輝達還將面臨另一項重大考驗：預定周二公布的財報。曾擔任輝達財務長逾十年的克瑞斯(Colette Kress)已獲任命為代理執行長，公司目前正在尋找正式接任人選。
在財報公布前，分析師關注輝達管理層是否會大舉實施庫藏股，以支撐股價。截至9月底，輝達尚有2,350億美元的庫藏股買回授權額度。
但投資人最關注的問題之一，遠超過財報電話會議預料將揭露的資訊：輝達下一任正式執行長將由誰出任？
由Joshua Buchalter領軍的TD Cowen分析師周四指出，黃仁勳離職讓輝達留下領導空缺，除了由克瑞斯帶領財務之外，公司還需要具備「明確技術與營運權威」的人選。
TD Cowen分析師寫道：「這可能導致一種非典型的領導架構。」
分析師也指出，接班人選將決定輝達未來的發展方向，情況可能類似蘋果(AAPL-US)從具有遠見的Steve Jobs，轉型由更重視營運管理的Tim Cook接班。

接班布局牽動台積電關係 關鍵人才去留成焦點

TD Cowen表示，執行長交接也可能影響輝達與客戶及供應商的關係，其中最重要的是與台積電(TSMC-US)(2330-TW)的合作關係。若客戶或供應商轉而離開輝達，「將是情勢尚未穩定的明確跡象」。
未來其他待解問題還包括輝達的AI投資將如何處理，以及誰能接替黃仁勳，成為AI產業「最積極發聲的倡議者與傳道者」。分析師表示，目前還不清楚公司有多少投資可能必須撤回。
這場局勢對整個產業都有廣泛影響。TD Cowen指出，隨著黃仁勳的聲譽「受到玷污」，目前還不清楚誰能填補他在AI產業推廣方面留下的空缺。
此外，在AI人才市場競爭「極為激烈」的情況下，輝達能否留住關鍵高層與員工，也受到質疑。TD Cowen分析師寫道：「關鍵人才出走及留任決策，都將牽動股價。」
paras_en: Investors continue to digest the shock from Jensen Huang stepping down as chief executive, and Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares fell another 2.01% on Friday the 13th, pushing the market‑value back under $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025. The stock has dropped 12.7% this week, marking a sixth straight week of losses – the longest losing streak since 2012 – and the company erased $573.34 billion in market value, the biggest weekly loss in its history.
The share decline reflects market doubts about whether AI spending can be sustained and the lingering fallout from Huang’s resignation as CEO.

AI‑spending return concerns persist, Nvidia’s weekly decline lags chip peers by more than 20 percentage points. According to Dow Jones market data, Nvidia fell 12.7% this week, extending a six‑week losing streak. The last longer run of weekly declines was a six‑week stretch that ended in October 2012.

Nvidia’s performance this week also lagged the broader semiconductor sector. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) rose 8.1% while Nvidia trailed by 20.8 percentage points, the widest weekly gap since 2008, per Dow Jones data.

Even before the controversy surrounding Huang drew attention, Nvidia’s stock was already under pressure. The market remains uneasy about the durability of AI spending, especially given the operating conditions of emerging cloud service firms and the possibility that data‑center build‑out could slow amid a tougher political environment.

Moreover, Huang’s sudden resignation – reportedly linked to a senior executive with a Nvidia customer and two employees involved in an extramarital affair – forces the company to confront the fallout from that scandal.

Next week’s earnings report presents another major test. Nvidia is slated to release its results on Tuesday, and long‑time CFO Colette Kress, who has served in the finance chief role for over a decade, has been appointed interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

Ahead of the earnings release, analysts are watching whether Nvidia will launch a large share‑buyback program to support the stock. As of the end of September, the company still has $235 billion of authorized buy‑back capacity remaining.
But one of investors’ top concerns far exceeds what the earnings call is expected to reveal: who will be named Nvidia’s next permanent chief executive?

TD Cowen analysts led by Joshua Buchalter noted on Thursday that Huang’s departure leaves a leadership vacuum; beyond Kress handling finance, the company needs a candidate with “clear technical and operational authority.”
The analysts wrote: “This could result in an atypical leadership structure.”
They also pointed out that the successor will shape Nvidia’s future direction, perhaps echoing Apple’s transition from visionary Steve Jobs to the more operations‑focused Tim Cook.

The succession plan also touches Nvidia’s relationship with TSMC (TSMC-US, 2330‑TW). TD Cowen warned that a CEO change could affect Nvidia’s ties with customers and suppliers, especially the critical partnership with TSMC; a drift away would be a clear sign of instability.

Other unresolved questions include how Nvidia will handle its AI investments and who will replace Huang as the industry’s most vocal AI advocate. Analysts say it is still unclear how much of the company’s AI‑related capital may need to be pulled back.
The situation has broad implications for the entire sector. TD Cowen said that with Huang’s reputation “tainted,” it is uncertain who can fill the gap he left in promoting AI across the industry.

Finally, in an “extremely competitive” AI talent market, doubts remain about Nvidia’s ability to retain key executives and staff. TD Cowen analysts wrote: “Key talent departures or retention decisions will move the stock.”

items.title: 通膨惡化 戴莉：Fed可能需要升息
items.title_en: Inflation Worsens, Daly: Fed May Need to Raise Rates
paras: 《路透社》報導，舊金山聯準銀行總裁戴莉(Mary Daly)週五(13日)表示，她「傾向認為」聯準會(Fed)可能需要調高政策利率，尤其是服務業通膨正朝不利方向發展，且已有部分跡象顯示通膨持續性正在增強。
戴莉在內華達大學拉斯維加斯分校商業與經濟研究中心的活動中表示，「我們很可能需要升息。我將在12月的會議及未來所有會議中，與同僚審慎討論，並共同做出我們認為最符合經濟發展狀況的決策。生產商愈來愈常告訴我們，他們已經沒有太多空間繼續自行吸收成本、壓縮利潤，因此確實開始考慮將成本轉嫁給消費者。這正是我們希望避免的通膨壓力。」
排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心消費者物價指數(CPI)在過去三個月每月約上漲0.3%。這遠高於若要使年通膨率維持在Fed 2%目標水準所需的月增0.2%或更低幅度。
戴莉與其他幾位決策官員一樣，特別擔憂排除住宅成本後的服務業通膨「並未朝正確方向發展」。這尤其令人憂心，因為這部分通膨通常具較強的黏著性。
她談到，「這種情況可能出現在零售商或專業服務業者身上。當他們必須購買價格更高的資訊科技產品、支付更高的能源帳單，以及面對其他投入成本上漲時，就可能考慮將這些成本轉嫁給消費者。」
Fed已於9月調升政策利率，但10月決定維持利率不變。金融市場目前高度押注，Fed將在12月8日至9日及明年1月26日至27日的兩次會議上，各升息1碼。戴莉表示，她認為市場已理解Fed如何根據經濟情勢決定利率，但並未針對未來升息的具體時間表發表評論。
隨著12月政策會議接近，戴莉也表示，她正密切關注消費者支出。消費支出占美國經濟活動的大部分，是觀察經濟走勢的重要指標。
戴莉表示，「消費者支出仍出乎意料的具有韌性，至今還看不到明顯縮減。因此，接下來一到三個月，我真正想觀察的就是這項數據的變化，尤其是在假期購物季期間：當價格上漲時，消費者會開始縮減支出，還是會繼續消費？」
她進一步指出，「身處拉斯維加斯……我們才剛開始聽到一些訊息，顯示消費者可能快要沒力了。而且現在其他州也傳出類似情況，不只是內華達州。」
paras_en: Reuters reported that Mary Daly, President of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, said on Friday the 13th that she "leans toward" believing the Fed may need to raise its policy rate, especially as services‑inflation is moving in an unfavorable direction and there are signs that inflation persistence is strengthening.

Speaking at an event hosted by the Business and Economic Research Center of the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, Daly said, "We are very likely to need to raise rates. I will discuss this carefully with my colleagues at the December meeting and at all future meetings, and we will make the decision we believe best fits the economic outlook. Producers are increasingly telling us they have little room left to absorb costs and compress margins, so they are indeed beginning to consider passing costs on to consumers. That is the inflation pressure we want to avoid."

Excluding the more volatile food and energy prices, the core consumer price index (CPI) has risen about 0.3% per month over the past three months, well above the roughly 0.2% monthly increase needed to keep annual inflation at the Fed’s 2% target.

Like several other policymakers, Daly is especially worried that services‑inflation, after stripping out housing costs, "is not moving in the right direction." This is concerning because that component of inflation tends to be highly sticky.

She noted, "This situation can arise with retailers or professional service providers. When they have to buy more expensive information‑technology products, pay higher energy bills, and face other input‑cost increases, they may consider passing those costs on to consumers."

The Fed raised its policy rate in September but left it unchanged in October. Financial markets are now heavily betting that the Fed will raise rates by one basis point at each of its two meetings on Dec. 8‑9 and Jan. 26‑27. Daly said she believes the market understands how the Fed decides rates based on economic conditions, but she did not comment on the timing of any future hikes.

As the December policy meeting approaches, Daly said she is closely watching consumer spending. Consumer expenditure makes up the bulk of U.S. economic activity and is a key gauge of the economy’s trajectory.

Daly said, "Consumer spending remains surprisingly resilient, and we have not yet seen a clear cut‑back. So over the next one to three months, what I really want to watch is how this data evolves, especially during the holiday shopping season: when prices rise, will consumers start to pull back spending or keep on buying?"
She added, "Being in Las Vegas… we are just starting to hear some signals that consumers may be running out of steam. And now similar reports are coming from other states, not just Nevada."

items.title: 俄羅斯也想搶黃仁勳？俄議員喊話延攬：這種人才屈指可數
items.title_en: Russia Also Wants to Snag Jensen Huang? Russian Lawmaker Calls for Recruitment: Such Talent Is Few in the World
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 共同創辦人黃仁勳卸下執行長職務，下一站引發外界揣測。馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 在社群平台 X 回應網友建議他聘用黃仁勳時說，「那會是我的榮幸。」俄羅斯國家杜馬議員戈列爾金 (Anton Gorelkin) 近日也公開喊話，建議俄國科技大廠評估延攬黃仁勳，借重他在先進晶片與人工智慧 (AI) 產業的經驗。
輝達董事會週四 (12 日) 宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即日起生效，由財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 兼任代理執行長。
在輝達正式公布人事異動前，擔任俄羅斯國家杜馬資訊政策、資訊科技與通訊委員會第一副主席的戈列爾金便建議俄國科技大廠密切關注事態發展。
他表示，黃仁勳的價值遠超過一般企業經理人，因為他熟悉尖端處理器的開發與量產，也了解全球科技供應鏈和整個 AI 產業如何運作。
戈列爾金形容，全球同時具備這些經驗的人全球「屈指可數」。
戈列爾金預期，黃仁勳的動向將引起全球大型科技公司與獵才業者關注。
他形容，美國人親手把黃仁勳推向全球人才市場，等於送給輝達競爭對手一份「難以想像的厚禮」。
他說，競爭對手若想追上輝達，可能得砸下數百億美元投入研發、花上數年追趕，還得逐一挖角工程師。如今，這些公司有機會直接延攬一手打造輝達、熟悉整家公司如何運作的共同創辦人。
戈列爾金指出，俄國正大力投入本土微電子與 AI 研發，並著手設立研究中心、培育工程人才。
他認為，黃仁勳若有意赴俄，可以分享產業經驗，協助當地企業把晶片研發、生產與供應鏈管理串接起來。
黃仁勳於 1993 年與兩名夥伴共同創辦輝達，早期聚焦遊戲與多媒體市場的 3D 繪圖。輝達於 2006 年推出 CUDA，讓開發者能運用繪圖處理器 (GPU) 的平行運算能力處理科學計算等工作。2012 年，使用輝達 GPU 訓練的深度學習模型 AlexNet 在影像辨識競賽取得突破，成為 GPU 從遊戲繪圖走向 AI 運算的代表案例。
俄羅斯近年積極擴大本土微電子產能。
俄國工業與貿易部長阿里哈諾夫 (Anton Alikhanov) 今年 9 月表示，俄製晶片與電子元件目前約占當地市場 26%。
依分析人士估算，這項比重到 2030 年可望升至 44% 至 48%，產值接近 8,000 億盧布。俄國計畫興建工廠、開發本土設備，並協助業者將研發成果推進到量產。
輝達早在 2022 年就暫停對俄出貨，並於同年 10 月宣布停止在俄羅斯的所有業務。戈列爾金這次公開喊話，正值俄國試圖擴大本土晶片供應之際。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) co‑founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, sparking speculation about his next move. When Elon Musk was asked on X whether he would hire Huang, he replied, "It would be my honor." Russian State Duma member Anton Gorelkin recently made a public appeal, urging Russian tech giants to consider recruiting Huang and leveraging his experience in advanced chips and artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia's board announced on Thursday the 12th that Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO.

Before Nvidia formally announced the personnel changes, Gorelkin—who serves as first vice‑chair of the Duma’s Committee on Information Policy, Information Technology and Communications—suggested that Russian tech firms closely monitor the development.

He said Huang’s value far exceeds that of a typical corporate manager because he is familiar with the development and mass production of cutting‑edge processors and understands how the global tech supply chain and the AI industry operate.
Gorelkin described people worldwide who possess this combination of experience as "few and far between."
He expects Huang’s move to attract attention from major global tech companies and headhunters.
He likened the fact that Americans have personally propelled Huang onto the global talent market to giving Nvidia’s rivals an "unimaginably generous gift."

He said that competitors who want to catch up with Nvidia may have to spend hundreds of billions of dollars on R&D, take years to close the gap, and poach engineers one by one. Now those companies have the chance to directly hire the co‑founder who helped build Nvidia and knows how the whole company works.
Gorelkin noted that Russia is heavily investing in domestic micro‑electronics and AI research, establishing research centers and training engineering talent.
He believes that if Huang were interested in going to Russia, he could share industry expertise and help local firms integrate chip development, manufacturing and supply‑chain management.

Huang co‑founded Nvidia in 1993 with two partners, initially focusing on 3D graphics for gaming and multimedia. Nvidia launched CUDA in 2006, enabling developers to use GPU parallel‑processing power for scientific computing and other tasks. In 2012, the deep‑learning model AlexNet, trained on Nvidia GPUs, achieved a breakthrough in image‑recognition competitions, marking the transition of GPUs from gaming graphics to AI computation.
Russia has been actively expanding its domestic micro‑electronics capacity in recent years.
Russia’s Minister of Industry and Trade Anton Alikhanov said in September that Russian‑made chips and electronic components currently account for about 26% of the local market.

Analysts estimate that this share could rise to 44%‑48% by 2030, with a market value approaching 800 billion rubles. Russia plans to build factories, develop domestic equipment, and help companies move R&D results into mass production.

Nvidia halted shipments to Russia as early as 2022 and announced in October of that year that it would cease all operations in the country. Gorelkin’s public appeal comes as Russia seeks to expand its domestic chip supply.

items.title: 〈分析〉黃仁勳走人韓廠反看機會 HBM議價力或升 韓企研擬Plan B
items.title_en: Analysis: Jensen Huang’s Exit May Boost Korean Memory Chip Makers’ Bargaining Power; Korean Firms Draft a Plan B
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳12日閃電辭職，由財務長克雷斯出任臨時執行長。《韓國先驅報》與《亞洲商務日報》訪問韓國產業人士與分析師後發現，當地晶片業正重新盤點手中的籌碼。
《韓國先驅報》報導，黃仁勳的離開可能反而增強韓國記憶體廠在未來供應談判中的地位。韓國半導體產業協會執行副會長Ahn Ki-hyun直言：「對我們來說可能反而更好。如果有另一家公司填補輝達留下的缺口，它還是需要我們的HBM。」
Ahn Ki-hyun認為，黃仁勳與韓國企業領袖的私人關係，不如輝達對少數記憶體供應商的依賴來得關鍵。「要更換供應商，輝達需要替代選項，但替代選項在哪裡？」他說，與其把供應集中在單一客戶身上，分散到數家客戶對韓廠可能更有利。目前全球HBM主要由SK海力士(000660KS)、三星電子(005930KS)與美光三家生產。
需求結構的數據也支持分散趨勢。LS證券估計，輝達佔全球HBM需求的比重將從2025年的66%降至2026年的57%；摩根士丹利預估，2027年輝達佔比將進一步降至37.3%，Google則達到36%。
研究機構SemiAnalysis創辦人Dylan Patel指出，黃仁勳親自鎖定了韓國的記憶體產能與台灣的晶圓代工產能，「這種掌控是個人的」。SemiAnalysis估計，SK海力士2027年對輝達的HBM4報價為每Gb 3至3.3美元，低於對超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與Google(GOOGL-US)等其他大客戶的3.7至4.1美元。
Patel認為雙方存在一種「默契」：SK海力士給予輝達記憶體優先供貨，輝達則優先供應GPU給SK集團的AI基礎建設業務。SemiAnalysis預期，少了黃仁勳，這種優惠待遇可能弱化，並釋出HBM產能給競爭對手。
《亞洲商務日報》則以「CEO熱線斷線」形容韓國企業的處境。韓國大企業與輝達的合作早已不限於晶片：現代汽車集團在自動駕駛與機器人、LG集團在AI與智慧工廠都與輝達結盟，如今都在評估新領導層下合作動能是否延續。
短期業務方面，韓國業界普遍認為影響有限。一家與輝達往來的企業主管表示，執行長更替不會改變Vera Rubin等次世代AI加速器的生產計畫，也不會影響韓國半導體廠已簽到2027、2028年的長期HBM4供應合約量。
但《亞洲商務日報》報導，韓企的「Plan B」已開始浮上檯面，方向包括擴大與輝達競爭對手的合作、分散客戶基礎。報導同時點出一項風險：此案涉及對中國間諜的指控（尚未證實），韓國業界憂心美國國會若因此進一步收緊對中國的半導體設備出口管制，韓廠在中國工廠的設備出貨可能受波及。
一家與輝達有業務往來的韓國企業主管向《韓國先驅報》透露，更令他擔心的是新業務：黃仁勳親自推動的AI工廠、物理AI與機器人專案，能否在沒有他的情況下維持同樣的推進速度。他預期現有合約會守住，但需要多年投資才能回收的項目，優先順序可能在新執行長手下改變。
對於輝達領導層變動，三星電子與SK海力士均拒絕置評。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang abruptly resigned on the 12th, with CFO Chris taking over as interim CEO. After interviews with Korean industry insiders and analysts by the Korea Herald and Asia Business Daily, local chip makers are reassessing their positions.

The Korea Herald reports that Huang’s departure could actually strengthen Korean memory manufacturers in future supply negotiations. Ahn Ki-hyun, executive vice‑president of the Korea Semiconductor Industry Association, said, “It might even be better for us. If another company fills the gap left by NVIDIA, it will still need our HBM.”

Ahn believes Huang’s personal ties with Korean business leaders matter less than NVIDIA’s reliance on a few memory suppliers. “To switch suppliers, NVIDIA needs alternatives, but where are those alternatives?” he asked. Spreading supply across multiple customers could be more advantageous for Korean fabs. Currently, global HBM is produced mainly by SK Hynix (000660KS), Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and Micron.

Demand data also supports diversification. LS Securities estimates NVIDIA’s share of global HBM demand will fall from 66% in 2025 to 57% in 2026; Morgan Stanley projects it will drop further to 37.3% in 2027, with Google reaching 36%.

Dylan Patel, founder of research firm SemiAnalysis, noted that Huang personally secured Korean memory capacity and Taiwanese wafer‑foundry capacity – “that control is personal.” SemiAnalysis estimates SK Hynix’s 2027 price for NVIDIA’s HBM4 will be $3‑$3.3 per Gb, lower than the $3.7‑$4.1 per Gb quoted to other major customers such as AMD (AMD-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US), Amazon (AMZN-US) and Google (GOOGL-US).

Patel sees a “mutual understanding”: SK Hynix gives NVIDIA priority memory supply, while NVIDIA supplies GPUs to SK Group’s AI infrastructure business. He expects that without Huang, this preferential treatment may weaken, freeing HBM capacity for rivals.

The Asia Business Daily described Korean firms’ situation as a “CEO hotline cut.” Cooperation between Korean conglomerates and NVIDIA goes beyond chips: Hyundai Motor Group partners with NVIDIA on autonomous driving and robotics, and LG Group on AI and smart factories, and both are now evaluating whether collaboration momentum will continue under new leadership.

In the short term, industry insiders say the impact will be limited. A senior executive at a company that works with NVIDIA said the CEO change will not alter production plans for next‑generation AI accelerators such as Vera Rubin, nor affect long‑term HBM4 supply contracts signed through 2027‑2028.

However, the Asia Business Daily reports that Korean firms’ “Plan B” is already taking shape, focusing on expanding cooperation with NVIDIA’s rivals and diversifying the customer base. The report also flags a risk: the case involves unverified accusations of Chinese espionage, and the Korean industry worries that the U.S. Congress might tighten semiconductor‑equipment export controls to China, potentially affecting equipment shipments to Korean factories in China.

A senior executive from a Korean company that does business with NVIDIA told the Korea Herald that he is even more concerned about new projects – AI factories, physical AI and robotics initiatives personally driven by Huang – and whether they can maintain the same pace without him. He expects existing contracts to hold, but projects that require years of investment to recoup may be reprioritized under the new CEO.
Both Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix declined to comment on the leadership change at NVIDIA.

華爾街並未完全放棄輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)。儘管本週陸續有分析師調整目標價，也有少數分析師下調評級，但許多追蹤這家公司的分析師仍維持看多立場。Wedbush分析師Matthew Bryson的一份報告，便充分反映了這種看法。Bryson週五(13日)在輝達下週公布財報前寫道，「一切都沒有改變。我們再次預期，輝達將繳出優於財測的成績，並且第四季營收展望將高於華爾街預期。」全文詳讀

黃仁勳走了還沒完！美財長開砲商務部 輝達也得說清楚

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares remain under pressure, down 14.4% so far this week and facing a possible sixth consecutive losing week – the longest weekly losing streak in 14 years – wiping about $657.2 billion of market value in a single week. With earnings due next Tuesday, the market will not only scrutinize the results but also look at share‑buyback activity, the CEO succession plan, and whether key partnerships with companies such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM-US) remain stable.

Wall Street has not completely abandoned Nvidia (NVDA-US). Although some analysts have adjusted price targets and a few have cut ratings this week, many still maintain bullish views. Wedbush analyst Matthew Bryson’s report reflects this sentiment: on Friday the 13th, ahead of Nvidia’s earnings release, he wrote, “Nothing has changed. We again expect Nvidia to deliver results that beat forecasts and that its Q4 revenue outlook will exceed Wall Street expectations.”

Nvidia’s senior‑management changes are unlikely to have an immediate direct impact on major Asian semiconductor suppliers such as Samsung Electronics and TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM-US). However, Jensen Huang’s departure raises questions about Nvidia’s long‑term product strategy and supply‑chain collaborations. For investors and suppliers, the key issues are whether Nvidia can sustain its historic pace of innovation and preserve the close partner relationships that Huang cultivated to cement the company’s AI‑chip leadership.

The AI IPO boom is running into geopolitical hurdles. According to foreign media citing informed sources on Friday the 13th, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is facing obstacles for Chinese and Hong Kong institutional investors to subscribe to its upcoming IPO. Despite recent volatility in AI stocks, the deal has attracted strong buying interest, with potential investors expressing demand roughly six times the number of shares being offered.

U.S. export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China have led to a new finding: former OpenAI researcher Will DePue disclosed on Friday the 13th that six AI models – DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and three models from Ant Group – show a “hardware fingerprint” in their publicly released weights that matches Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) Blackwell chip. The fingerprint suggests the hardware used during model initialization, though the location of the chips and how the firms obtained the compute remain unclear.

The Nvidia controversy has spilled further into the U.S. administration. Financial Times and Bloomberg report that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly said the Treasury and several other agencies have supported placing Megaspeed on the trade blacklist for months, but the final decision rests with the Commerce Department. He also called for accountability of Nvidia personnel, questioning whether the company has adequately vetted customers and prevented its chips from reaching China.

items.title: AI代理夯 LangChain募3億美元 估值達30億
items.title_en: AI Agent Startup LangChain Raises $300 Million, Valued at $3 Billion
paras: AI代理管理新創LangChain宣布完成3億美元C輪募資，估值達30億美元，由Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下創投CapitalG領投。新加坡主權基金GIC、DFJ Growth、IVP與Sapphire Ventures也參與投資，累計募資總額達4.6億美元。
本輪其他投資人包括Salesforce Ventures、Insight Venture Partners、QuantumLight及MongoDB Ventures；既有投資人Sequoia、Amplify與Benchmark也加入。LangChain未公布這筆資金的具體用途，但公司表示將於11月20日展示LangSmith的新功能。
新估值約為一年前的2.4倍。LangChain當時募得1.25億美元，估值為12.5億美元，由IVP領投；此次融資反映投資人持續看好企業導入AI代理的需求。
LangChain於2022年以開源專案起家，早期協助大型語言模型搜尋網路、呼叫API及操作資料庫。隨著OpenAI、Anthropic及Google等模型業者提升模型處理這類工作的能力，LangChain將業務重心轉向AI代理的建置、部署與管理。
公司的核心產品LangSmith提供AI代理的執行、測試、監控、改善與治理工具。LangChain主打模型與雲端中立，讓企業自行選擇模型、掌握資料及基礎設施，避免被單一供應商綁定。
LangChain表示，已有超過7,000個組織使用LangSmith，客戶包括新創Harvey、Rippling與Listen Labs，以及輝達(NVDA-US)、豐田(TM-US)、Salesforce(CRM-US)、Workday(WDAY-US)等企業。
公司舉例，Clay透過LangSmith每月監控數億次AI代理執行並改善代理效能；Workday則運用該平台在企業內部署及管理代理，將推出新代理所需時間從五個月縮短至不到一天。
不過，AI代理管理市場競爭升溫，其他新創也主打開放選擇模型與企業自主治理等賣點。LangChain的先行優勢與7,000多個組織客戶，有助其建立市場基礎；後續能否把開源開發者社群轉化為穩定的企業軟體收入，仍是高估值能否持續的關鍵。
paras_en: AI agent management startup LangChain announced the completion of a $300 million Series C round, valuing the company at $3 billion. The round was led by CapitalG, the venture arm of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). Singapore sovereign fund GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures also participated, bringing the total amount raised to $460 million.

Other investors in this round included Salesforce Ventures, Insight Venture Partners, QuantumLight and MongoDB Ventures; existing backers Sequoia, Amplify and Benchmark also participated. LangChain did not disclose the specific use of the funds, but said it will showcase new features of LangSmith on November 20.

The new valuation is about 2.4 times that of a year ago. At that time LangChain raised $125 million at a $1.25 billion valuation, led by IVP; this financing reflects investors’ continued confidence in demand for AI agents in enterprises.

LangChain started in 2022 as an open‑source project, initially helping large language models search the web, call APIs and operate databases. As model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google have improved their ability to handle these tasks, LangChain has shifted its focus to building, deploying and managing AI agents.

The company’s core product, LangSmith, provides tools for executing, testing, monitoring, improving and governing AI agents. LangChain emphasizes model‑ and cloud‑agnosticism, allowing enterprises to choose their own models, control data and infrastructure, and avoid vendor lock‑in.

LangChain says more than 7,000 organizations use LangSmith, with customers ranging from startups like Harvey, Rippling and Listen Labs to enterprises such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Toyota (TM‑US), Salesforce (CRM‑US) and Workday (WDAY‑US).

The company cites examples such as Clay, which monitors hundreds of millions of AI agent executions each month via LangSmith and improves agent performance, and Workday, which uses the platform to deploy and manage agents internally, cutting the time to launch a new agent from five months to less than a day.

However, competition in the AI agent management market is heating up, with other startups also touting open model choice and enterprise‑controlled governance. LangChain’s first‑mover advantage and its base of over 7,000 organizational customers help it build market footing, but whether it can convert its open‑source developer community into stable enterprise software revenue will determine if the high valuation is sustainable.

items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Posts Biggest Weekly Gain Since September as Fed Rate Hikes Near Certain
paras: 美元周五(13日)再創19個月新高，並寫下9月中旬以來最強單週表現。這波漲勢主要受到市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期大幅升高所帶動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.41，創2025年4月2日以來新高。本週已上漲1.1%。
美元這波漲勢始於上週五美國就業報告公布後。美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，遠高於市場預期的6.5萬人。此外，8月與9月的就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。
美元週一短暫喘息後，週二再度走高，主要因美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據高於預期。10月整體CPI月增0.4%，低於9月的0.6%，但仍高於市場預期的0.3%。排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增率維持在0.3%，略高於市場預期的0.2%。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場表現強勁，通膨也持續居高不下。在此情況下，央行通常會採取緊縮貨幣政策。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)週二進一步釋出鷹派訊號，表示即使通膨數據低於預期，他仍支持升息，他並指出，若數據再度偏熱，政策利率甚至可能需要一次調升50個基點，高於一般升息幅度。
週五公布的最新生產者物價指數(PPI)報告，則稍稍緩解市場疑慮。10月整體PPI月增0.3%，明顯低於9月的1.4%，也低於市場預期的0.4%。年增率則為6.5%，略低於預期的6.6%。不過，這仍是2022年11月以來最大的12個月漲幅。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond表示，「好消息是，生產者物價通膨已從9月高點降溫。壞消息是，降幅可能還不足以讓市場獲得期待中的利率緩解。生產者物價通膨年增率仍高達6.5%，今天公布的報告提高了限制性利率維持更長時間的風險，恐怕超出投資人原先預期。」
他補充，「或許比整體數字更重要的是，通膨壓力正從能源擴散到其他領域。10月能源價格實際下跌，但食品價格上漲1.3%，服務業價格連續第五個月上漲，運輸與倉儲成本也增加2.0%。這顯示通膨正逐漸滲透至整體經濟，而非僅集中在最初出現價格壓力的領域。若這種情況持續，Fed就更難將通膨視為暫時現象。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員幾乎篤定Fed將在12月升息，問題在於升息幅度。市場預期升息25個基點的機率接近90%，升息幅度高達50個基點的機率則約為10%。
日元再度貶破160關卡
美元走強對日元造成壓力，日元兌美元匯率本週創下9月中旬以來最差單週表現。日元最新報159.76兌1美元，稍早盤中一度觸及160.19的低點。
這是日元連續第二個交易日貶破160關卡。週四日元才首次自9月2日以來跌破此水準。過去，160關卡曾多次觸發東京當局大規模干預匯市。
日本財務省週一表示，7月至9月期間，日本在外匯市場干預操作中共動用15.4兆日元（約963.8億美元），其中包括7月30日單日創紀錄的7.98兆日元，以及7月31日與華府採取史無前例聯合行動時投入的5.55兆日元。這是美日自1998年以來首次聯手買進日元。
日本財務省負責外匯事務的最高官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)警告市場應提防「單邊走勢」，並提醒交易員，「現在就忘記」美日聯合干預還言之過早。
美元走強也使歐元承壓。歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1.1022美元，本週創下10月初以來最差單週表現。
稍早公布的官方初值估計顯示，歐元區2026年第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)季增0.4%，低於第二季的0.6%，但符合市場預期。數據也更新了勞動市場狀況，歐元區第三季就業成長則呈現停滯。

paras_en: The dollar hit a 19‑month high on Friday (the 13th) and recorded its strongest weekly performance since mid‑September. This rally was driven mainly by a sharp rise in market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.41, a peak not seen since April 2, 2025. It is up 1.1% for the week.

The dollar’s advance began after Friday’s U.S. jobs report. Non‑farm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, far above the 65,000 forecast, and the August‑September combined payroll figure was revised up by 84,000.

After a brief pause on Monday, the dollar moved higher again on Tuesday, largely because U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data came in hotter than expected. October’s overall CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, down from September’s 0.6% but still above the 0.3% market estimate. Core CPI, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast.

The data show a still‑robust labor market and persistently high inflation, conditions that typically prompt central banks to tighten policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled further hawkishness on Tuesday, saying that even if inflation data miss expectations he still backs a rate hike and noted that a repeat of hot data could warrant a 50‑basis‑point move, larger than the usual increment.

The latest producer price index (PPI) released on Friday eased some concerns. October’s overall PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, well below September’s 1.4% and the 0.4% market forecast. The year‑over‑year rate was 6.5%, just under the 6.6% expected, but it remains the biggest 12‑month gain since November 2022.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said, “The good news is that producer‑price inflation has cooled from its September peak. The bad news is that the decline may not be enough for the market to see the rate‑cut relief it hopes for. Producer‑price inflation is still at a 6.5% annual pace, and today’s report raises the risk that restrictive rates will have to stay in place longer than investors originally expected.”

He added, “Perhaps more important than the headline number is that inflation pressure is spreading from energy to other areas. Energy prices fell in October, but food rose 1.3%, services posted a fifth consecutive month of price gains, and transportation and warehousing costs rose 2.0%. This shows inflation is seeping into the broader economy rather than staying confined to the initial price‑pressure zones. If this continues, it will be harder for the Fed to treat inflation as a temporary phenomenon.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are almost certain the Fed will raise rates in December, with the question being the size of the hike. The market assigns roughly a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point increase and about a 10% chance of a 50‑basis‑point move.
The yen slipped past the 160 per dollar barrier again.

A stronger dollar put pressure on the yen, which posted its worst weekly performance since mid‑September. The yen was last quoted at 159.76 per dollar, after briefly touching a low of 160.19 earlier in the session.

This marks the second consecutive trading day the yen fell below the 160 level. It first breached that threshold on Thursday, the first time since September 2. Historically, the 160 barrier has often triggered large‑scale intervention by Tokyo authorities.

Japan’s Ministry of Finance said on Monday that between July and September it intervened in the foreign‑exchange market for a total of ¥15.4 trillion (about $96.38 billion), including a record ¥7.98 trillion on July 30 and ¥5.55 trillion on July 31 when it coordinated an unprecedented joint action with Washington. This is the first time since 1998 that the U.S. and Japan have jointly bought yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of foreign‑exchange affairs at the Ministry, warned the market to beware of “unilateral moves” and told traders that it was “still too early to say the joint U.S.–Japan intervention is over.”
A stronger dollar also weighed on the euro. The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1022, marking its weakest weekly performance since early October.

Preliminary official estimates released earlier showed Euro‑area GDP grew 0.4% quarter‑on‑quarter in Q3 2026, down from 0.6% in Q2 but in line with expectations. The data also revised labor‑market conditions, indicating that employment growth stalled in the third quarter.

items.title: 日元逼近160關卡！日本匯率主管再警告市場勿忘夏季干預 暗示可能單獨出手
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Barrier! Japan's Exchange Rate Chief Warns Market Not to Forget Summer Intervention, Hints at Possible Solo Action
paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the critical 160 level where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Atsushi Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the foreign‑exchange market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late to early‑August intervention that bought yen, including coordinated actions with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S.; that three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.

A weak yen has been a persistent headache for Japanese policymakers, driving up import costs. Data released on Thursday showed the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation elevated, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo may resort to unilateral intervention."

paras: 美國通膨持續升溫，加上聯準會（Fed）官員接連釋出鷹派訊號，市場升息預期急速升溫，ICE 美元指數周三（11 日）一度升至 102.96，創下 19 個月新高。
隨著交易員開始押注聯準會 12 月可能一口氣升息 2 碼，短期美債殖利率飆升，全球主要貨幣普遍承壓，美元漲勢成為市場關注焦點。
隨著交易員開始將聯準會 12 月升息 2 碼納入定價，美債殖利率走揚、全球主要貨幣承壓，美元成為金融市場關注焦點。
行情數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的 ICE 美元指數(DXY) ，周三盤中最高觸及 102.96，創下 2025 年 4 月以來最高水準。
另一項廣受市場關注的彭博美元指數，也創下今年 6 月以來最大兩日漲幅，盤中觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。美元當天兌幾乎所有主要貨幣均走強，顯示買盤持續湧入。
美元本波漲勢在周二明顯加速，主要受到美國通膨數據與聯準會官員鷹派言論雙重推動。
最新數據顯示，美國 10 月消費者物價漲幅連續第三個月高於市場預期，促使交易員重新評估聯準會未來升息幅度，甚至開始將 12 月一次升息 50 個基點（2 碼）的可能性納入定價。
隨著短期美債殖利率飆升，美國與其他主要經濟體之間的利差擴大，進一步吸引追求較高報酬的資金流向美元資產。
12月升息1碼機率達88% 華爾街上修預測
加拿大帝國商業銀行（CIBC）策略師 Jeremy Stretch 表示，美元近期走強，核心原因在於市場持續重新調整對聯準會貨幣政策路徑的預期。
他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。
除了美元走強，法國債務問題持續拖累歐元，加上近期油價回落，市場對歐洲央行升息的預期也有所降溫。
荷蘭合作銀行（Rabobank）外匯策略師 Jane Foley 指出，歐洲央行上次新聞發布會透露，管理委員會對經濟成長前景的擔憂日益加深。
她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month high.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

The Bloomberg Dollar Index, also closely watched by the market, posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that October’s U.S. consumer price inflation rose above expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.

As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the interest‑rate gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% – Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in one move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts three consecutive hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How much higher can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could cause the dollar to give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening interest‑rate differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute this year’s dollar strength partly to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking the 1.11‑dollar barrier and extending the decline from the previous session, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and falling oil prices have cooled market expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank FX strategist Jane Foley said the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a far‑right victory could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes keep rising, markets will closely watch U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.

items.title_en: NY Fed Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Near 160, Fed 12‑Month Rate‑Hike Odds Up to 87%
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周三(11日)攀高，聯準會(Fed)官員接連發表鷹派談話，加上美國通膨數據比預期火熱，正在助長聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.68%，報102.90，盤中觸及2025年4月以來最高水準。
美元兌日元升值0.69%，報159.84日元，升至逾兩個月來最高水準，並逼近心理關卡160日元。
歐元兌美元貶值0.65%，報1.11美元，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及2025年5月以來最低水準。
美國10月消費者物價連續第三個月高於預期，促使交易員進一步提高對Fed 12月升息的押注。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場預期聯準會12月升息1碼(25個基點)的機率，已從一個月前約70%升至87%。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，升息預期升高有助於支撐美元。
Haddad表示：「美元普遍走強，主要受到Fed利率預期轉趨鷹派支撐。這項轉變由高於預期的10月CPI數據推動，近期Fed官員的談話也進一步放大了這股趨勢。」
包括Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)及達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)在內的官員都表示，對通膨居高不下感到不安，華勒甚至不排除大幅升息2碼(50個基點)的可能性，進一步推升市場升息押注。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.50%，報1.33美元，接近兩周來最低點。美元兌瑞士法郎則上漲0.93%，報0.833瑞郎，盤中一度升至10月中旬以來最高水準。

高盛與德銀調整預測 今年多數主要貨幣走貶

周二的通膨數據公布後，部分券商調整對Fed未來貨幣政策的預測。高盛目前預期，Fed將在12月及明年3月升息，德意志銀行則預期，升息時間點將落在12月、明年1月及3月。
除了澳幣與挪威克朗外，多數已開發市場貨幣兌美元今年來均走貶，原因是利差擴大推升美元。部分分析師也將美元今年走強歸因於美國與以色列對伊朗開戰期間，市場資金流向避險資產。
澳幣兌美元貶值0.23%，報0.685美元，美元兌挪威克朗則上漲0.61%，報9.55挪威克朗。
加密貨幣方面，比特幣上漲0.93%至74,460.41美元，以太幣上漲1.19%，報2,079.31美元。

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Wednesday (11th), as Fed officials delivered a series of hawkish remarks and U.S. inflation data outpaced expectations, boosting the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.68% to 102.90, hitting its highest level since April 2025 during the session.
The dollar strengthened 0.69% against the yen, trading at 159.84 yen, its highest level in over two months and approaching the psychological 160‑yen barrier.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar, trading at 1.11 dollars, continuing its decline from the previous day and reaching its lowest level since May 2025.

U.S. October consumer price inflation exceeded expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to raise their bets on a Fed rate hike in December. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in December rose from about 70% a month ago to 87%.
Elias Haddad, Global Market Strategy Head at Brown Brothers Harriman, said that higher rate‑hike expectations help support the dollar.

Haddad added, “The dollar is broadly stronger, largely due to the shift toward hawkish Fed rate expectations. This shift is driven by October CPI data that beat forecasts, and recent Fed officials’ remarks have further amplified the trend.”

Fed officials, including Governor Christopher Waller and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, expressed concern over persistently high inflation, with Waller even not ruling out a substantial 50‑basis‑point hike, further lifting market rate‑hike bets.

The pound fell 0.50% against the dollar, trading at 1.33 dollars, near its lowest point in two weeks. The dollar rose 0.93% against the Swiss franc, trading at 0.833 francs, briefly reaching its highest level since mid‑October.
Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank revised forecasts, expecting most major currencies to depreciate this year.

After the Tuesday inflation data release, some brokers adjusted their Fed policy outlooks. Goldman now expects rate hikes in December and March next year, while Deutsche Bank projects hikes in December, January, and March next year.

Except for the Australian dollar and Norwegian krone, most developed‑market currencies have weakened against the dollar this year, driven by widening interest‑rate spreads that lift the dollar. Some analysts also attribute the dollar’s strength to risk‑off flows during the U.S.‑Israel conflict with Iran.
The Australian dollar fell 0.23% against the dollar, trading at 0.685 dollars, while the dollar rose 0.61% against the Norwegian krone, trading at 9.55 krone.
In crypto, Bitcoin rose 0.93% to $74,460.41, and Ethereum climbed 1.19% to $2,079.31.

As of Wednesday (11th) around 6:30 a.m. Taiwan time, the dollar index was 102.9160, down 0.01%; EUR/USD was 1.1087, down 0.01%; GBP/USD was 1.3270, down 0.04%; AUD/USD was 0.6847, down 0.03%; USD/CAD was 1.4249, down 0.01%; USD/JPY was 159.68, down 0.11%.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the "single currency law package" by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate their work to ensure the overall preparation has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on November 10, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that "Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different." He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s dependence on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: it will serve as a complement to cash and will never replace it.

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data privacy, the transaction fee structure, and limits on individual holdings.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Revive as Yen Slides to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Mark
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak trend in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday and marking a new low not seen since late September, roughly a month and a half ago.

Analysts say that U.S. CPI data that came in hotter than expected sparked renewed expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, sending U.S. Treasury yields sharply higher and widening the U.S.–Japan yield gap. This attracted carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, pushing the yen lower further.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have delivered hawkish remarks, providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller warned before the inflation data release that if core inflation hit 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider a two‑rate‑step (50‑basis‑point) hike the following month. After the data, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that even stronger inflation could require a faster tightening pace, while Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee bluntly called the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata of the First Life Economic Research Institute offered a different view. He believes the market is over‑reacting to speculation of a two‑step hike in December; as pricing settles on a one‑step (25‑basis‑point) increase, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is likely to be limited.

Analysts also think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to curb further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show policymakers remain highly vigilant about upside inflation risks and support taking additional tightening steps. Fueled by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued weakness boosts profitability for Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials are significantly weighing on corporate margins and adding pressure to domestic consumer prices.
